notes: SwarmBrain is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its argument-free constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 BRAIN to msg.sender, the deploying factory. No subsequent mint or burn is exposed, and transfers have no fee. No application contracts are included. pool.initialPrice records provenance; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
